purpose: Teach: 安売り/値動き/外装/試用/贈呈/発案/損得/取り立て

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 安売りキャンペーンは限定的に行いましょう
lines.en: Let's keep the discount campaign limited in scope.
lines.style: Measured, businesslike. Slight upward inflection on 'limited' — clarity of decision. Direct eye contact. Professional warmth without hesitation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。仮想通貨の値動きを参考にしません
lines.en: Understood. We won't be using cryptocurrency fluctuations as a reference point.
lines.style: Attentive nod in the voice. Quiet confirmation, not echoing. Slightly faster pace. Shows he's already thinking ahead to the next point.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 新店舗の外装色を社員投票で決めましょう
lines.en: Let's have the staff vote on the exterior color for the new location.
lines.style: Engaged, inclusive tone. Light emphasis on 'staff vote' — genuine interest in including people. Open delivery, inviting input.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新製品の試用結果を集計中です
lines.en: Understood. I'm currently compiling the results from the new product trials.
lines.style: Steady, practical. Matter-of-fact delivery. Small pause after the dash to signal transition. Shows active progress without over-reporting.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 創立記念に社員へ贈呈品を用意しましょう
lines.en: Let's prepare gifts for the staff to mark our founding anniversary.
lines.style: Warm, purposeful. Slight softening on 'gifts' — this matters personally, not just procedurally. Calm, deliberate pace.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員発案の新事業を支援します
lines.en: Understood. I'm supporting the new business initiative that came from the staff suggestions.
lines.style: Affirming, encouraging in a quiet way. Emphasis on 'supporting' — shows commitment. Steady, reliable delivery. Voice carries quiet conviction.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: お客様の損得を考えた提案をしましょう
lines.en: Let's make sure our proposals genuinely consider what's best for the customer.
lines.style: Sincere, grounded. Opens with quiet conviction. Slight weight on 'genuinely' — this is the principle, not just procedure. Calm, unhurried delivery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。督促の取り立て時には敬意を持ちます
lines.en: Understood. When collecting overdue payments, we'll always treat people with respect.
lines.style: Firm but kind. Final word carries the weight of a commitment. Slower pace. Closing tone — this is a line drawn, held with gentleness.
